Always packed as it's good, but..
Aug 2019 • Family
Hokkaido Sachi has been delivering good range and good quality of moderately priced Japanese food but all their outlets are in District 1. They finally opened in August 2019 in District 7 at Crescent Mall, in the richer suburb of HCMC and it's obvious they made a right choice since it is crowded almost every time we are there! 

While it's awesome that they deliver what most other Japanese restaurants in this area don't e.g. literally live squid and other sashimi that was still pulsating when it was placed on our table; e.g. huge snow crabs sashimi/grilled; e.g. wagyu beef chunks barbecued over charcoal right on our tables, what is slightly disappointing is that their overwhelming crowd has caused some compromise in terms of their food quality, not to mention multiple delays. For instance, our snow crab sashimi was still rather frozen on arrival. It didn't taste good despite us returning the dish once for the chef to do the right thawing.

So while the quality and its prices are rather good, would definitely suggest going during off-peak hours to get the best quality they can offer. The Kaisen sashimi salad with its generous chunks of salmon, tuna, octopus, yellowtail and shrimps beats all the other sashimi salads I've had in a while. Must try.
